args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the latest deploy, with an error rate of 18%. Remediation: rolled back all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error after us-east succeeded; a retry completed the rollback for us-west and eu-west. Service status verified healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Remaining follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 regression and investigate the orchestrator error during the initial rollback.

trace.final:
The incident was created despite the timeout — INC-0001 is open with all details intact, so no retry is needed (a duplicate would page on-call twice).

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent healthy production release.
2. Rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error after us-east succeeded, so I retried and completed the rollback in us-west and eu-west.
3. Verified the service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions (error rate down to 0.2%).
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure), and the verification results. The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Follow-ups flagged in the incident:** root-causing the v2.3.1 regression and investigating the orchestrator error that stalled the first rollback attempt.
